variants.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Task: replace ONLY the niqab/headwear of Image1 by faithfully transferring the actual NIQAB SHAPE from Image2, which is the user's approved photo or existing app avatar. The user explicitly forbids invented niqab designs. Image1 is target full-body avatar: keep its woman identity and eyes, standing pose, hands, full abaya design, bright blue sleeveless work vest, small correct "I am special" chest artwork without white rectangle, and both ivory cream Nike V2K Run trainers UNCHANGED. Image2 is HEADWEAR CONSTRUCTION REFERENCE ONLY: reproduce its real forehead/head band, eye opening, face veil length/shape, layers and draping without adding novel trim, seams or layers. Copy the reference's fitted round forehead cap with its subtle horizontal seam, horizontal slim eye opening, straight long hanging cloth face veil and shoulder drape. Do NOT retain the target's broad rectangular stiff forehead band, because the reference uses a fitted cap. Match reference exactly. ALL headwear fabrics must be jet black, including cap, band, niqab and headscarf. Adapt to target's original head scale and three-quarter angle. Do not copy reference identity or shoe type. One complete full-body figure, true transparent alpha background, no outside glow, no floor, no cropped feet, no labels or watermark.
variants.garmentPrompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Create ONE new full-body Saudi female employee avatar as an individual transparent PNG asset for a React app, premium realistic 3D illustrated character. Image 1 is the EXISTING app avatar: preserve its woman identity, visible eyes, natural proportions, standing three-quarter pose, both hands relaxed and anatomy, entire vivid royal blue open sleeveless work vest with pockets and curved lower corners, and exact Nike V2K Run ivory cream mesh trainers and silver swooshes. Preserve footwear model on BOTH FEET. Do not copy any background glow from image 1. Image 2 is exact company brand artwork: faithfully place it SMALL on the left chest (viewer right), red text exactly "I am special" on two lines, yellow brush stroke, yellow pencil left, red blue green yellow puzzle right; remove ONLY the outer WHITE background, retain yellow background within artwork; no white badge or rectangle and no invented typography. Reference garment and niqab photos specify clothing only, not wearer identity. Saudi abaya must be modest loose ankle length, feet fully visible, and wearable beneath original blue vest. Headscarf, forehead band, face niqab and abaya MUST all use the exact same cloth base color. Modern fabric niqab only with eyes showing; separate straight forehead band and hanging face panel; no gold, no metallic burqa, no ornament or logo on niqab. Full figure head to toe, no crop, both complete shoes, consistent perspective and character height, restrained studio lighting with visible fabric construction. Actual transparent alpha background, NO backdrop, NO glow, NO floor, NO shadow outside silhouette, NO halo, NO labels, no captions, no watermark. Deliver just ONE avatar. Keep crisp high-quality silhouette. Variant A: abaya and niqab JET BLACK. Image 3 is the user's abaya reference: a flowing generous A-line front opening with silver-grey leaf/vine embroidery along the front lapels, BOTH cuffs and long vertical outer side panels. Adapt it faithfully beneath the vest, so embroidery is clearly visible on wide cuffs and below vest to ankle. Image 4 niqab reference: broad straight black forehead band, narrow horizontal eye slit, long flat soft face veil to upper chest with a gently curved lower edge, black head drape. Image 5 Saudi Nusoq product reference informs wide loose tailoring and leaf embroidery. Distinct Saudi garment construction, no cinched waist, no exposed neck or hair.
